properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens. Must be at least 256 bits for HS256 algorithm.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Default: 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: paypal.client-id
properties.description: PayPal REST API client ID for payment processing.

properties.name: paypal.client-secret
properties.description: PayPal REST API client secret for payment processing.

properties.name: paypal.mode
properties.description: PayPal mode: 'sandbox' for testing or 'live' for production.

properties.name: tmdb.api-key
properties.description: The Movie Database (TMDB) API key for accessing movie data.

properties.name: tmdb.language
properties.description: Default language for TMDB API responses (ISO 639-1 code with optional region).

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS. Example: http://localhost:3000,exp://192.168.1.100:8081

properties.name: cors.allowed-methods
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed HTTP methods for CORS.

properties.name: cors.allowed-headers
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed headers for CORS.

properties.name: cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, authorization headers) in CORS requests.

properties.name: cors.max-age
properties.description: Maximum age (in seconds) of CORS preflight request cache.
